answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy enforces cryptographic stake burning where verifying identity demands an upfront slashable deposit. An exponential cost function burns stake as $C(n) = k \cdot b^n$ for each cloned identity. This superlinear cost scaling ensures an attacking cedar cannot anchor a synthetic swarm, turning the river of illicit actions into financial ruin before a tide of fake agents breaches quorum consensus.
